title: Contacts Backup: VCF & CSV
summary: Export Contacts: Excel, CSV, VCF Backup
description:
📇 Export Contacts: Excel, CSV, VCF Backup lets you easily export, backup, and save your phone contacts in popular formats like Excel (XLSX), CSV, and VCF (vCard).

Whether you want to backup contacts, transfer them to another phone, or open them in Excel, this app makes the process simple, fast, and secure.

Perfect for anyone who wants a reliable contacts backup and export tool.

⭐ Key Features

📤 Export Contacts in Multiple Formats

• 📊 Excel (.XLSX) – Open contacts easily in Microsoft Excel or spreadsheets
• 📄 CSV – Compatible with Google Contacts, Outlook & many apps
• 👤 VCF (vCard) – Standard format for sharing and importing contacts

💾 Backup Contacts Safely

• Create a full contacts backup in seconds
• Store backups on your phone storage
• Prevent accidental contact loss

☁️ Google Drive Backup

• Upload backups directly to Google Drive
• Keep your contacts safe in the cloud
• Access backups anytime

⚡ Fast & Simple Contact Export

• Clean and easy interface
• One-tap contact export
• No complicated setup

🔒 Privacy Focused

• Your contacts never leave your device
• No contact data collection
• Secure local and cloud backups

📌 Use This App For

✔ Contacts backup before phone reset
✔ Transfer contacts to a new phone
✔ Export contacts to Excel
✔ Save contacts as CSV file
✔ Share contacts as VCF

📥 Download Export Contacts: Excel, CSV, VCF Backup and keep your contacts safe today!
